notes: Fixed a real bug (found from a user-reported run) where companies from the wrong country/region kept showing up - e.g. Indian, Chinese, and US companies appearing in a Europe-only market report. The location-detection logic was too narrow (only caught phrases like 'headquartered in X') and missed common real-world cases like an Indian address, phone number, or a company simply mentioning its own country on its site. Also fixed: a couple of company listings pointed at trade-directory pages or an expired/resold domain instead of the company's real website, and a bug where a website starting with 'www.' could cause a real company to be wrongly flagged as suspicious. Reminder: if a run still looks thin or off for a market, first check that your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key.
